intro.label: Pocket
intro.body: Hats roll in; bass waits two bars then drops into the A pocket.

intro.label: Figure
intro.body: In the intro, the root on 1, the root again on the and of 2, and down to the minor seventh on the a of 2 — it anchors the downbeat.

intro.label: Harmony
intro.body: Pedal Am7 (i7) — same as the main chord-name row. Bass outlines A–C–E–G color tones through Intro.

intro.label: Missable
intro.body: In Intro, leave the root on 3 and the fifth on 4 alone — a fill on top of them covers the figure.

a1.label: Pocket
a1.body: Four-feel kit under an A-center funk line. Sit behind the kick; hats mark the 8ths.

a1.label: Figure
a1.body: In Groove A, the root on 1 locks with the kick, the root again on the and of 2 locks with the kick, and down to the minor seventh on the a of 2 — it anchors the downbeat.

a1.label: Harmony

a1.label: Missable

verse.label: Pocket
verse.body: Back to Am7 pocket — lock the written syncopations.

verse.label: Figure
verse.body: When the groove returns, the root on 1 locks with the kick, the root again on the and of 2 locks with the kick, and down to the minor seventh on the a of 2 — it anchors the downbeat.

verse.label: Harmony

a2.label: Pocket
a2.body: Same pocket with denser octave pops — don’t rush the ghost notes: quiet snares into the backbeat, and the soft bass 16ths.

a2.label: Figure
a2.body: In Groove A′, the root on 1 locks with the kick, the octave on the a of 1, and the root again on the and of 2 locks with the kick — it anchors the downbeat.

a2.label: Harmony
a2.body: Pedal Am7 (i7) — same as the main chord-name row. Bass outlines A–C–E–G color tones through Groove A′.

a2.label: Missable
a2.body: In Groove A′, leave the root on 3 and the root on 4 alone — a fill on top of them covers the figure.

b1.label: Pocket
b1.body: Lift to D7; keep the kick 1 + syncopation while the root moves.

b1.label: Figure
b1.body: On the lift, the root on 1 locks with the kick, up to the major third on 2, and the root again on the and of 2 locks with the kick — an arpeggio of the chord that anchors the downbeat.

b1.label: Harmony
b1.body: Lift sits on D7 (IV7 in Am) — matches the main chord row. Bass roots on D.

b1.label: Missable
b1.body: In Lift, leave the root on 3 and the root on 4 alone — a fill on top of them covers the figure.
